what: Engram feature parity: chunked git sync and obsidian export
why: All Engram-inspired features have been implemented: conflict surfacing (judge/compare), lifecycle review, soft-delete, passive capture, chunked Git sync, and Obsidian export
learned: Chunked sync uses one file per memory ID in .sv-memory/chunks/ to avoid Git merge conflicts. Obsidian export writes .md files with YAML frontmatter and [[wikilinks]]. All tests pass.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: All Engram competitive features ported. Build clean, all tests pass.
next_steps: Verify obsidian-export command works end-to-end, update spec.md with new tool count (16 tools), potentially add CLI auto-completion for new commands
